LanguageData.Raven_Projectile_BlowgunDart.label: [Raven] Stimulation Dart
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_Blowgun.label: [Raven] Blowgun
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_Blowgun.description: A simple but effective blowgun commonly used by Raven assassins. It fires darts coated in a potent stimulation toxin that dissipates into gas upon impact.\n\nThe physical damage caused by this weapon is extremely low, but it can effectively break the enemy's will.
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_HiddenBlade.label: [Raven] Hidden Blade
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_HiddenBlade.description: A retractable blade mounted under the wrist. It allows the wielder to launch sudden and lethal attacks while concealed.\n\nSpecial Effect: After remaining out of combat for 10 seconds, the next attack will deal 3x damage and have extremely high armor penetration.
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_SilentSniper.label: [Raven] Phantom Sniper Rifle
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_SilentSniper.description: A highly sophisticated sniper rifle with an integrated suppressor. It is tailor-made for Raven infiltrators.\n\nSpecial Effect: Staying still accumulates "Steady Aim", significantly increasing shooting accuracy. Moving will lose this bonus.
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_StandardCleaver.label: [Raven] Standard Cleaver
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_StandardCleaver.description: A Raven Fusang standard issue cleaver.
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_Raven: A highly automated suppression machine gun developed specifically for elite combat units by the Raven Fusang Armory. Its ultra-high fire rate and reinforced rounds make it a moving bullet storm on the battlefield â€” although the damage per shot is low, its extremely high stopping power can pin enemies in place.\n\nSpecial Effect: Staying still accumulates "Steady Aim", dramatically improving accuracy the longer you stand.
